digest.component_or_area: git fetch timeout handling across multiple subsystems
propositions: Three remaining 300s git fetch call sites lack low-speed abort protection, exposing each to identical wall-clock timeout stalls as the fixed snapshot path
The low-speed abort seam built for snapshot fetches (stall_abort_args and is_stall_abort) is module-public and reusable by other call sites without snapshot-specific coupling

Applying the stall abort options to review bot gerrit_client, opcert_service workspace, and init command fetch calls requires splicing stall_abort_args() into their subprocess argv without duplicating abort logic
A dribbling remote above the throughput floor must not trigger stall abort, while a zero-byte remote must abort within ~10s rather than at the 300s wall-clock ceiling
